opening.argument: The video is identified as an animation contest submission, and its description expressly states, "This is not an official promotional video for GoDark, it was made solely for educational purpose only." The narration presents GoDark as a private crypto-trading concept, describing hidden intent, private execution, liquidity, and anonymity, then directs viewers to "Get early access now at GodarkDX.com." Those promotional elements do not establish that the creator endorses the service, that an operating service or website exists, or that the depicted claims are true. The supplied material also provides no evidence of affiliation, transaction outcomes, losses, or any resulting user harm. The contest context and stated educational purpose therefore support treating the video as an educational technology and operational demonstration, while the limitations prevent a stronger conclusion.
